title: Actor identity is dev or dev/agent; model and reasoning are attributed actor context, not part of the id
outcome: ENGRAM_ACTOR_ID names the principal (greg, or greg/claude, greg/codex) and stays the target of assignment, handoff, and --mine; an optional ENGRAM_ACTOR_CONTEXT (for example model=opus-4.1;reasoning=high) is recorded as attribution on every event and shown by show, memories, and history without fragmenting actor equality
acceptance: events, notes, memories, and evidence record the actor context when the host supplies it and omit it when absent; handoff --to greg/codex matches regardless of context
show and memories render actor plus context in one short line; no new refusal class and no change to claim or session semantics

completion.summary: Added bounded optional actor-context attribution across CLI, MCP, work events, evidence, memories, and agent projections without changing actor/session authority or persisted shapes; normalized unsafe input, kept agent protocol and gate/project-memory replay stable, and added typed non-mutation, parity, escaping, and replay regressions.
